sloka: रामस्यैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा धर्मयुक्तं मनोगतम् ।शत्रुघ्नो दीनया वाचा बाढमित्येव चाब्रवीत् ।। ७.७२.१८ ॥
transliteration: rāmasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā dharmayuktaṁ manogatam ।śatrughno dīnayā vācā bāḍhamityeva cābravīt ।। 7.72.18 ॥

translations.english: Having heard these righteous and heartfelt words of Rama, Shatrughna, with a humble voice, simply replied, "Indeed."
